description: Eight unrelated single-language sources (en, fr, de, es, ja, pt, it, nl), no shared primary language and therefore no tiebreakers. A deliberately flat set: nothing here can be decided by tiebreaker order, and CLDR fallback is reachable only from an explicitly regional range, so the Accept-Language cases that use it isolate weight ordering, list ordering, q=0 rejection, header parsing, and the parsed-range limit.
